storage: Store in a clean, dry airtight jar at room temperature away from heat and moisture, with a dry spoon.
looksLike: A golden, grainy-to-smooth fat that is solid in cool weather and liquid when warm, with a nutty, buttery smell.
howToPick: Check the pack says pure cow ghee (not vanaspati), is within date and has a clean nutty smell and even colour. Avoid a rancid or soapy smell.
shelfLife: Packs usually carry about 9 to 12 months (check the pack; general guidance).
substitutes: Homemade ghee from butter or malai
